Discover a smarter way to manage your documents with Document Reader & PDF Editor — the all-in-one file viewer designed for work, study, and everyday use. Easily open, read, organize, and manage all your files in one convenient app.

Support for PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and more means you no longer need multiple apps to handle different file formats. Whether you’re reviewing reports, reading notes, or managing presentations, Document Reader & PDF Editor makes everything simple and efficient.

📂 Smart File Organizer
• Automatically scans and organizes files on your device
• Browse documents by category: PDF, DOC, XLS, PPT, and more
• Quickly access recent and favorite files
• Fast search to find documents instantly

📕 Powerful PDF Reader
• Open and read PDF files smoothly
• Zoom in/out for comfortable reading
• Jump directly to specific pages
• Share PDF files anytime

📝 Word Document Viewer
• Supports DOC and DOCX files
• Clean and easy-to-read interface
• Automatically detects all Word documents on your device

📊 Excel Spreadsheet Viewer
• Open XLS and XLSX files quickly
• View tables, charts, and data clearly
• Great for reports, budgets, and office work

📽️ PPT Viewer
• Smooth presentation viewing experience
• Supports PPT and PPTX formats
• Perfect for meetings, classes, and quick reviews

🔧 Useful PDF Tools
• Convert images to PDF
• Export PDF pages as images
• Merge PDF files easily
• Add annotations and drawings
• Full-text document search

⚡ Why You’ll Love It
✔ Lightweight and fast performance
✔ Simple and user-friendly design
✔ Sort files by name, date, or size
✔ Rename, delete, and share documents easily
✔ Works offline anytime, anywhere

🚀 More Features Coming Soon
• Support for ZIP, RAR, HTML, XML, and more
• Advanced document editing
• Dark mode support

Document Reader & PDF Editor helps you keep all your files organized and accessible in one place. No more switching between apps or dealing with unsupported formats — just a smooth and reliable document experience on your phone.

📥 Download Document Reader & PDF Editor today and turn your device into a portable office!
